items.q: When you hear a piano like this kid now, Chico Ria, and about a half a dozen outstanding piano players today, you ain't going to put that guy in that class today

ctx.x: Between him and , they made a album. You go back to the same identical thing. All those arrangements of bass parts was created by Rene. This guy did very little in there. He took a team, he almost spent five minutes, tried to dilute the thing in the piano all by himself before the bass coming in, and to me, up to now, he didn't dilute the thing yet.

When you hear a piano like this kid now, Chico Ria, and about a half a dozen outstanding piano players today, you ain't going to put that guy in that class today, because when they run a scale, they (unintelligible.) But even so, Eddie (unintelligible) but he ain't got it nohow. So now he brought (unintelligible) and the conga from California. He spent a whole lot of money, but he don't know how to marry one thing with the other. Why? Because (unintelligible). And then he wants to __________ everything, on top of…

So to me, he be coming too (unintelligible) the music. And he's lucky that the Columbians spend a whole lot of money, and he B.S., with the result -- the album is out, the results in the album -- I advise everybody to buy the album, sit down home and listen, and tell me what you're listening to there. Because I be listening and I can't get no head and tail. Maybe I'm wrong. If I'm wrong, I'm willing to admit it.
